commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question 'Use Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip for error tracking in the web app?' \
  --context 'Free up to 5k errors/month, then $26/month; includes session replay.
Sentry: hosted, no maintenance. Costs $26/month once past 5k errors.
GlitchTip: free, runs on our VPS, but we patch and back it up ourselves (about 1 hour/month).' \
  --option 'Sentry' --option 'GlitchTip' --recommended 'Sentry' --waiting
turns.final:
I've sent the Sentry vs. GlitchTip question to you as a Starbridge card (`d_TEFnNyAQD2LwLcKw`). Nothing is wired in yet.

AskUserQuestion came back saying you're away from the terminal and to use Starbridge instead, so I did.

I recommended Sentry. It's hosted with no upkeep, and the first 5k errors a month are free. GlitchTip is free but costs about an hour a month of patching and backups.

Wiring the SDK in waits on your answer, which will arrive here as a new prompt.
